item.title: End User: Users should be aware of censorship on social platforms
item.description: Censoring practices need to be abolished, or at the very least, made transparent to users so they are aware the information they receive may be filtered. Users should take it upon themselves to learn more about the existence of censoring practices to avoid unknowingly becoming shadow banned. The post End User: Users should be aware of censorship on social platforms appeared first on The Ithacan.

item.title: Editorial: Transparency is key to addressing problems with student org budgets
item.description: So many people’s college experiences are built upon student organizations and extracurriculars. item.description: After fighting into double overtime, the No. 23 Ithaca College women’s lacrosse fell 15-14 to the University of Scranton Royals on March 7 at Higgins Stadium.
